camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-cors --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Configures cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) rules for a specified bucket
description_zh: 设置指定存储空间（Bucket）的跨域资源共享CORS（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）规则
name: PutBucketCors

element_fields.help_en: The allowed origins for cross-origin requests
element_fields.help_zh: 指定允许的跨域请求来源
element_fields.name: allowed_origin

element_fields.help_en: The allowed methods for cross-origin requests
element_fields.help_zh: 指定允许的跨域请求方法
element_fields.name: allowed_method

element_fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the headers specified in Access-Control-Request-Headers in an OPTIONS preflight request are allowed. Each header specified in Access-Control-Request-Headers must have a corresponding entry in AllowedHeader.

Only one asterisk (*) wildcard character is allowed
element_fields.help_zh:
控制OPTIONS预取指令Access-Control-Request-Headers中指定的Header是否被允许。在Access-Control-Request-Headers中指定的每个Header都必须在AllowedHeader中有对应的项。

仅允许使用一个星号（*）通配符
element_fields.name: allowed_header

element_fields.help_en:
The response headers that users are allowed to access from an application, such as a JavaScript XMLHttpRequest object.

The asterisk (*) wildcard character is not allowed
element_fields.help_zh:
指定允许用户从应用程序中访问的响应头。例如一个JavaScript的XMLHttpRequest对象。

不允许使用星号（*）通配符
element_fields.name: expose_header

element_fields.help_en:
The cache duration for the browser to cache the response of an OPTIONS preflight request for a specific resource. Unit: seconds.

Only one MaxAgeSeconds is allowed per CORS rule
element_fields.help_zh:
指定浏览器对特定资源的预取（OPTIONS）请求返回结果的缓存时间。单位为秒。

单条CORS规则仅允许一个MaxAgeSeconds
element_fields.name: max_age_seconds

fields.help_en:
The container for CORS rules.

A maximum of 10 CORS rules can be configured for each bucket. The uploaded XML document can be up to 16 KB in size
fields.help_zh:
CORS规则的容器。

每个Bucket最多允许10条CORS规则。上传的XML文档最大允许16 KB
fields.name: cors_rule

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the Vary: Origin header. Valid values:

true: The Vary: Origin header is returned regardless of whether the request is a cross-origin request or whether the cross-origin request succeeds.
false (default): The Vary: Origin header is not returned in any case.

This field cannot be configured independently. At least one cross-origin rule must be configured for this field to take effect
fields.help_zh:
是否返回Vary: Origin头。取值范围如下：

true：不管发送的是否是跨域请求或跨域请求是否成功，均会返回Vary: Origin头。
false（默认值）：任何情况下均不返回Vary: Origin头。

此字段不能单独配置，必须至少配置一项跨域规则才能生效
fields.name: response_vary

parameters.help_en: The container that stores the CORS rules for the bucket
parameters.name: cors_configuration

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for configuring CORS rules
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 设置跨域资源共享规则的请求体
v1_body_parameters.name: body
